title: CoolDock: a second Mac dock with live widgets shown on a calm landscape
attribution_visible_in_image: Apple glyph and 'Your smart second Dock' (mockup copy); no creator credit visible.
contains_third_party_content: Apple logo, system-style app icons (Safari, Music and others), a landscape photograph that looks generated or stock, artist name 'Dake'.

observed.layout: Hazy green-hills photo. Small Apple glyph and 'Your smart second Dock'. Massive black headline 'A useful Dock for live widgets.' Along the bottom, a long dark translucent dock with five modules: a clock '10:42 Wed, Jun 17'; weather '26° Today' with three forecast columns that each read 'Thu / 30°'; a 2x2 app icon block; a green ring meter reading '57'; a music player (album art, 'Music name / Dake', progress bar, previous / play / next).
observed.typography: Heavy black grotesque headline; small white module text. Typeface unconfirmed.
observed.iconography: System-style app icons and playback glyphs.
observed.materials: Dark translucent modules over a photo; equal heights and radii.

implementation_notes: Modules share height, radius and tint; the bar is a flex row.
Real implementation needs live data and system integration.

concept_work.essence: The product mock is the page's base, so the visual proves the claim.
what_makes_it_work: Modules are the same height and radius, so the bar reads as one system.
Dark modules on a light ground give strong figure/ground.
The headline is the largest thing and the dock is second.
gaps_to_make_it_work: The three forecast columns all read 'Thu' and '30°'; the ring reads '57' with no unit or label; a dated 'Wed, Jun 17' sits beside 'Thu' days.
No offer or CTA is shown; the Apple logo implies a relationship that is not shown.

use_when: Showing a utility surface in context

must_preserve: Dark modules on a light ground
adaptation_examples: Status bar widget for a dev tool over a landscape hero.

lessons: Proofread placeholder data: repeated values undermine a product mock.

measured.palette_method: Median-cut quantization of the supplied image plus saturated-pixel hue medians. Approximate (JPEG). Items marked 'approx' were judged by eye.
measured.color_roles: Dark translucent modules on a bright landscape; green ring is the single color accent.
measured.contrast_method: Estimated from compressed images. Background = dominant color in a box around the text. ratio_low = conservative estimate (mean of the most distant ~4% of pixels). ratio = best estimate (mean of the most distant ~1.5% of pixels; for text on a saturated background that appears near-white or near-black, the text is assumed pure white or black, because anti-aliasing of small text otherwise understates the contrast). Accessibility scores use ratio_low; critical failure CF1 uses ratio. Gradient or photo backgrounds are measured one text line at a time. Values within 0.4 of a threshold are borderline and should be verified in the source file.

evidence: The product and its claim are clear.
Strong figure/ground and a clean, airy composition.
Product-page conventions are met, but repeated placeholder data and an unlabeled ring weaken content correctness.
No offer or CTA; module states are not shown.
Modules share size, radius and tint.
Scored on conservative values: primary text min 10.81:1; secondary text min 3.22:1; icon min n/a:1; non-color state cue: True.
accessibility.basis: computed from measured contrast + cue flag (scope: contrast and non-color cues only; touch targets, motion and screen-reader support cannot be assessed from a static image)

evaluation.readiness_key: A = ship with minor adjustments (>=80, no critical failure); B = needs specific fixes (60-79); C = rethink (<60)
evaluation.scope: Scored as presented in a static image. States, motion and behavior that are not shown are not scored as present.
